user.title: Connect to Aqara Studio
user.description: Connect directly to the local Aqara Studio Open API. HTTP sends the bearer token unencrypted; use HTTPS where available or a trusted local network.

data_description.host: Local hostname, IP address, or HTTP(S) origin. HTTPS certificate verification is always enabled.
data_description.token: Stored in the Home Assistant config entry. Never post it in an issue or include it in a screenshot.

mapping.title: Confirm sensor meanings
mapping.description: The Aqara specification does not define contact or leak boolean polarity. Choose a mapping only if you have verified it. Otherwise keep Unconfirmed, finish setup, inspect raw values beside Studio, then change these options after physical tests. Each mapping applies to all included sensors of that type.

data_description.contact_polarity: Confirm against Studio and a physical open/close test. Unconfirmed sensors report unknown and expose their raw value.
data_description.leak_polarity: Confirm against Studio and a safe wet/dry test. Unconfirmed sensors report unknown and expose their raw value.

data_description.token: Stored in the Home Assistant config entry. Never post it in an issue or include it in a screenshot.

reconfigure.title: Update the Studio connection
reconfigure.description: The original identity gateway must still be present. Leave the token blank to keep the existing credential.

data_description.host: Local hostname, IP address, or HTTP(S) origin. HTTPS certificate verification is always enabled.
data_description.token: Stored in the Home Assistant config entry. Never post it in an issue or include it in a screenshot.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Studio API. Check the address, local network, and API availability.
error.invalid_auth: Studio rejected the token or its access scope.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname, IP address, or HTTP(S) origin without user credentials, query parameters, or an unrelated path.
error.unsupported_response: Studio did not provide the documented inventory and stable gateway identity.

abort.already_configured: This Studio instance is already configured.
abort.wrong_instance: This address or credential belongs to a different Studio instance. The original identity gateway must be present.
